# Grounding Answers in Retrieved Evidence

## Abstract

We study a 13B model on TriviaQA. Retrieval improves accuracy substantially.

## Setup

We compare a closed-book baseline (B) with its retrieval-augmented variant (R). We also report an ablation that adds a reranker (R+).

## Results

Table 2 reports accuracy in percent.

| System | Accuracy | Latency (ms) |
|---|---|---|
| B | 58.0 | 300 |
| R | 66.5 | 520 |
| R+ | 67.0 | 610 |

## Conclusion

Adding retrieval improves accuracy by 8.5 points over the closed-book baseline.
